data.answer_quote: So I think we've been clear on our distribution policy and certainly our dividend policy. We said we're going to shift to a 40-55% payout ratio from next year. We do expect, subject to seeing how the second quarter goes, to be in a position to pay an interim dividend in the middle of the year and then re-evaluate whether or not we'll shift the quarterly dividends at the end of this year.
